title: rhobound-mcp job_status
description: The `job_status` tool (ARCHITECTURE.md 5.5). Server only (the CLI is synchronous). States are named as in the MCP Tasks extension. A job past its deadline_at reports failed with job.timeout, even if its worker died without writing anything. The root validates the output; $defs/input is the input schema.

wait_s.description: long-poll in stdio and container modes only; ignored on Lambda

findings_omitted.description: findings not listed, to keep the result within 2 KB (ARCHITECTURE.md 5.9)

examples_omitted.description: examples the check's findings carried: job_status lists none, so no raw trace value (a server.address) leaves the server (ARCHITECTURE.md 5.9)
